i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.intro: The preference lives in MMKV and i18next initializes synchronously at module scope, so the very first frame is already in the right language. Switching doesn't remount anything — react-i18next just re-renders whatever subscribed to t.

plural.description: Hermes ships no Intl.PluralRules, so the template pulls in the intl-pluralrules polyfill. Without it i18next falls back to a hard-coded English rule (count===1 picks _one): English looks perfectly fine, while Chinese has no _one form and leaks the raw key whenever the count is exactly 1.
plural.title: Interpolation and plurals

format.description: Everything goes through the single entry in feature/i18n/format — never new up an Intl formatter in a page. Hermes only ships Collator / DateTimeFormat / NumberFormat, so relative time is built from message keys plus plurals, not Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.
format.title: One formatting entry
